This file is for doing data import.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Importing our first dataset.

```{r}
litters_df =
  read_csv(file = 'data/FAS_litters.csv', skip = 0)

litters_df = janitor::clean_names(litters_df)
```

Import our second dataset
skipping 3 empty rows

```{r}
pups_df = 
  read_csv(file = 'data/FAS_pups.csv', skip = 3)

pups_df = janitor::clean_names(pups_df)
```

Head or tail

```{r}
head(litters_df, 20)

tail(pups_df, 5)
```

Skimming??

```{r}
skimr::skim(pups_df)
```
